title: expectedPrefix capability
expectation: the public seam accepts a previous complete cut and returns appendedCount/appendedTypes for a continuity proof
actual: snapshot seam reports appendedCount=0 appendedTypes=[]

title: prefix unchanged
expectation: no new events → appendedCount=0, same asOfSeq/eventCount/digest/references
actual: unchanged prefix proven (digest chain equal, appendedCount=0, 1 refs)

title: trusted recovery suffix
expectation: end-seed + interrupted closers + user-pinned fixed title are accepted, counted and reported by type; older cut keeps its digest
actual: accepted 5 trusted suffix events ["session/end-seed","tool/result","step/end","turn/end","session/title"]; prefix digest preserved, baseline references unchanged

title: foreign user/message in recovery suffix
expectation: a foreign event appended between the pre-resume cut and resume must reject the continuity proof; it is never discarded as recovery noise
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_CHANGED: NativeHistoryError: Native history changed outside the trusted recovery suffix

title: suffix bound
expectation: a recovery suffix larger than the declared maxAppendedEvents rejects instead of accepting unbounded recovery writes
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_LIMIT: NativeHistoryError: Native cold projection history exceeds the safe read bound

title: trusted suffix predicate
expectation: hand-built positive/negative matrix: exactly the SDK resume closers/end-seed/fixed user title pass; user/assistant/inbox/automatic-title/compaction events fail
actual: accepted 7 trusted events, refused 10 foreign/automatic events

title: live baseline binding
expectation: exact live object/id/header/preset/inherited/seq and the projected live inbox must all match; each mismatch rejects
actual: matching live binding accepted; all 5 mismatched bindings rejected

title: extend baseline by one exact event
expectation: a fixed-title/load-only style exact append is re-read at its exact seq, EOF confirmed, and the baseline extended; a stale, duplicated or inbox-splice append fails
actual: exact legitimate append extended the baseline; wrong validator, stale extra append and inbox splice all refused

title: native maintenance baseline observation
expectation: flush is performed, exactly one maintenance phase runs, and live identity/inbox are bound; running/disabled hosts reject without success
actual: one maintenance phase, 2 flushes, bound cut eventCount=140; running host and failed flush both rejected

title: observe with expectedPrefix
expectation: a foreign user/message appended after the pre-resume baseline is refused by the post-flush observation, never acknowledged
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_CHANGED: NativeHistoryError: Native history changed outside the trusted recovery suffix

title: allowAppended override
expectation: an explicit caller policy (not the default trusted native suffix) is honoured and the appended count/types reflect exactly what it admitted
actual: caller-controlled policy admitted exactly one user/message suffix event

title: compat inkbox helper
expectation: the array-shaped compatibility helper returns the same exact references as the snapshot and rejects malformed history the same way
actual: compat helper returned 1 identical references and refused malformed history

title: long-session recovery projection
expectation: after a trusted resume suffix on a long history, the same business Session id/preset and the whole projected inbox are preserved
actual: same Session shiyu-verify-long-recovery, preset shiyu-runtime-replyer-v1, asOfSeq=2604, 2 inbox refs after trusted suffix
